impact.en: Higher waves on the sea and lakes, risky for small boats and canoes
impact.sw: Mawimbi makubwa baharini na maziwani, hatari kwa vyombo vidogo na mitumbwi

en: Check TMA marine forecasts before going out.
Small boats and canoes: stay close to shore.
Wear a life jacket.
sw: Fuatilia utabiri wa TMA wa hali ya bahari na maziwa kabla ya kutoka.
Vyombo vidogo na mitumbwi: bakini karibu na ufukwe.
Vaa jaketi ya kujiokoa.

impact.en: Difficult conditions for night fishing
impact.sw: Mazingira magumu kwa uvuvi wa usiku

en: Avoid night fishing far from shore.
Carry a charged phone, a torch and a whistle.
Tell someone at the landing site where you are going and when you will return.
sw: Epuka uvuvi wa usiku mbali na ufukwe.
Beba simu yenye chaji, tochi na filimbi.
Mjulishe mtu mwaloni unakokwenda na muda utakaorudi.

impact.en: Unsafe conditions for swimming and beach activities
impact.sw: Mazingira yasiyo salama kwa kuogelea na shughuli za fukweni

en: Do not swim in rough water.
Keep children under adult supervision near water.
sw: Usiogelee kwenye maji yenye mawimbi makali.
Waweke watoto chini ya uangalizi wa watu wazima karibu na maji.

impact.en: Possible disruption to ferry and lake transport
impact.sw: Uwezekano wa usumbufu wa usafiri wa vivuko na maziwani

en: Check with ferry operators before travelling.
Allow extra travel time.
sw: Wasiliana na waendeshaji wa vivuko kabla ya kusafiri.
Weka muda wa ziada wa safari.

impact.en: Risk of boats capsizing, especially when overloaded
impact.sw: Hatari ya vyombo kupinduka, hasa vikiwa vimezidishiwa mzigo

en: Do not board an overloaded boat or ferry.
Make sure there is a life jacket for everyone on board.
Boat owners: check boats and engines before departure.
sw: Usipande chombo au kivuko kilichozidishiwa abiria au mzigo.
Hakikisha kuna jaketi ya kujiokoa kwa kila mtu chomboni.
Wamiliki wa vyombo: kagueni vyombo na injini kabla ya kuondoka.

impact.en: Waves reaching low-lying beaches and shore paths
impact.sw: Mawimbi kufika kwenye fukwe za chini na njia za ufukweni

en: Keep off rocks, piers and seawalls during high waves.
Keep away from the water's edge at high tide.
sw: Usikae juu ya miamba, gati wala kuta za bahari wakati wa mawimbi makubwa.
Kaa mbali na ukingo wa maji wakati wa maji kujaa.

impact.en: Some erosion of beaches and shoreline
impact.sw: Mmomonyoko wa baadhi ya fukwe na kingo za maji

en: Do not cut mangroves or remove beach vegetation.
Do not dig sand from beaches.
Report erosion to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Usikate mikoko wala kuondoa uoto wa fukweni.
Usichimbe mchanga fukweni.
Toa taarifa ya mmomonyoko kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Reduced visibility on the water from spray and swell
impact.sw: Kupungua kwa uwezo wa kuona majini kutokana na manyunyu na mawimbi

en: Reduce speed.
Use lights at night.
Travel together with other boats.
sw: Punguza mwendo.
Tumia taa usiku.
Safiri pamoja na vyombo vingine.

impact.en: Higher risk for fishers, boat passengers and people with special needs
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa wavuvi, abiria wa vyombo vya majini na watu wenye mahitaji maalum

en: Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees and Beach Management Units: review contingency plans, update the lists of boats and fishers and check rescue equipment.
Share this advisory with fishers, boat operators and coastal and lakeshore households.
sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata na Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Mialo (BMU): pitieni mipango ya dharura, boresheni orodha za vyombo na wavuvi na kagueni vifaa vya uokoaji.
Wapatie taarifa hii wavuvi, waendesha vyombo na kaya za pwani na kando ya maziwa.

impact.en: Possible damage to nets and fishing gear
impact.sw: Uwezekano wa uharibifu wa nyavu na zana za uvuvi

en: Move nets and gear above the high-water mark.
Secure boats at their moorings.
sw: Hamisha nyavu na zana juu ya usawa wa maji kujaa.
Funga vizuri vyombo mahali pa kuegesha.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Fishers and small boats at serious risk of capsizing
impact.sw: Wavuvi na vyombo vidogo katika hatari kubwa ya kupinduka

en: Stop all small-boat and night fishing.
Beach Management Units: stop boats from leaving landing sites.
District and Ward Disaster Management Committees: meet, activate contingency plans, prepare rescue boats and alert communities by radio, loudspeaker and door-to-door.
sw: Sitisha uvuvi wote wa vyombo vidogo na wa usiku.
Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Mialo (BMU): zuieni vyombo kutoka mialoni.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya na Kata: kutaneni, amilisheni mipango ya dharura, andaeni vyombo vya uokoaji na toeni tahadhari kwa jamii kupitia redio, vipaza sauti na nyumba kwa nyumba.

impact.en: Threat to life from drowning
impact.sw: Hatari ya maisha kutokana na kuzama majini

en: Do not go out on the water.
Boats already out: please return to the nearest safe shore.
Report missing fishers immediately to the Police or BMU, or call 190.
sw: Usitoke majini.
Vyombo vilivyo majini: tafadhali rudini ufukwe salama ulio karibu.
Toa taarifa ya wavuvi waliopotea mara moja kwa Polisi au BMU, au piga 190.

impact.en: Disruption to ferry and marine transport
impact.sw: Usumbufu wa usafiri wa vivuko na majini

en: Travel by ferry only if essential.
Follow instructions from ferry operators and TASAC.
Do not board overloaded vessels.
sw: Safiri kwa kivuko ikiwa ni lazima tu.
Fuata maelekezo ya waendeshaji wa vivuko na TASAC.
Usipande vyombo vilivyozidishiwa abiria au mzigo.

impact.en: Damage to jetties, piers and landing sites
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa gati, madaraja ya kushukia na mialo

en: Pull boats to higher ground or sheltered moorings.
Keep off jetties and piers.
Report damage to port authorities.
sw: Vuta vyombo kwenda sehemu za mwinuko au maegesho yaliyokingwa.
Usikae juu ya gati na madaraja ya kushukia.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa mamlaka za bandari.

impact.en: Significant beach and shoreline erosion
impact.sw: Mmomonyoko mkubwa wa fukwe na kingo za maji

en: Keep away from cliff edges and eroding banks.
Leave buildings at the edge of eroding shoreline.
Report erosion to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Kaa mbali na kingo za majabali na kingo zinazomomonyoka.
Ondoka kwenye majengo yaliyo ukingoni mwa fukwe zinazomomonyoka.
Toa taarifa ya mmomonyoko kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Waves overtopping seawalls and flooding low coastal roads
impact.sw: Mawimbi kuvuka kuta za bahari na kufurika barabara za pwani za chini

en: Avoid coastal roads at high tide.
Do not drive through water on roads.
Follow instructions from the Traffic Police.
sw: Epuka barabara za pwani wakati wa maji kujaa.
Usiendeshe gari kwenye maji yaliyofunika barabara.
Fuata maelekezo ya Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani.

impact.en: Damage to hotels and beach businesses
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa hoteli na biashara za fukweni

en: Hotel operators: move guests and activities away from the shoreline.
Suspend boat trips and water sports.
Secure beach furniture and equipment.
sw: Waendeshaji wa hoteli: hamisheni wageni na shughuli mbali na ufukwe.
Sitisha safari za boti na michezo ya majini.
Funga vizuri samani na vifaa vya fukweni.

impact.en: Loss of nets and fishing gear
impact.sw: Upotevu wa nyavu na zana za uvuvi

en: Move nets and gear well above wave reach.
Do not try to recover nets in dangerous conditions.
sw: Hamisha nyavu na zana mbali juu ya kufikiwa na mawimbi.
Usijaribu kuokoa nyavu wakati wa hali ya hatari.

impact.en: Flooding of low-lying coastal and lakeshore communities
impact.sw: Mafuriko katika jamii za pwani na kando ya maziwa zilizo maeneo ya chini

en: Households in low-lying coastal and lakeshore areas: please move to higher ground early.
Move before nightfall.
Follow instructions from Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Kaya zilizo maeneo ya chini ya pwani na kando ya maziwa: tafadhali hamieni maeneo ya mwinuko mapema.
Hameni kabla ya usiku.
Fuateni maelekezo ya viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Rising water damaging lakeside homes
impact.sw: Kupanda kwa maji kuharibu makazi ya kando ya maziwa

en: Raise food, documents and valuables.
Move livestock to higher ground.
Charge phones and keep a battery-powered radio.
sw: Inua chakula, nyaraka na vitu vya thamani.
Hamisha mifugo kwenda maeneo ya mwinuko.
Chaji simu na uwe na redio inayotumia betri.

impact.en: Disruption to schools in coastal and lakeshore areas
impact.sw: Kuathirika kwa shule za pwani na kando ya maziwa

en: Parents: keep children away from the shore and water.
School heads: follow directives from the District Education Office.
sw: Wazazi: waweke watoto mbali na ufukwe na maji.
Wakuu wa shule: fuateni maelekezo ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Severe risk of drowning and vessels capsizing
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa ya kuzama na vyombo kupinduka

en: No boat or ship movement on the sea or lakes.
Do not enter the water for any reason.
Follow directives from TASAC, the Police and District Committees.
sw: Hakuna chombo wala meli kusafiri baharini au maziwani.
Usiingie majini kwa sababu yoyote.
Fuata maelekezo ya TASAC, Polisi na Kamati za Wilaya.

impact.en: Loss of life in fishing communities
impact.sw: Vifo katika jamii za wavuvi

en: Boats still on the water: please go to the nearest safe shore immediately.
District Committees and Beach Management Units: account for all fishers and report the missing to the Police.
Fire and Rescue Force: lead search and rescue with the Police Marine Unit, TASAC and JWTZ.
sw: Vyombo vilivyo bado majini: tafadhali nendeni ufukwe salama ulio karibu mara moja.
Kamati za Wilaya na Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Mialo (BMU): hakikisheni wavuvi wote wanajulikana walipo na toeni taarifa ya waliopotea kwa Polisi.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: ongozeni utafutaji na uokoaji kwa kushirikiana na Polisi Wanamaji, TASAC na JWTZ.

impact.en: Storm surge flooding coastal communities
impact.sw: Mawimbi makubwa ya dhoruba kufurika jamii za pwani

en: Residents of low-lying coastal areas: please evacuate to higher ground as directed.
Do not go to the beach to watch the waves.
Please return only when the authorities declare the area safe.
sw: Wakazi wa maeneo ya chini ya pwani: tafadhali hamieni maeneo ya mwinuko kama mnavyoelekezwa.
Usiende ufukweni kutazama mawimbi.
Tafadhali rudini pale tu mamlaka zitakapotangaza kuwa eneo ni salama.

impact.en: Major damage to ports, harbours and ferry terminals
impact.sw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa bandari na vituo vya vivuko

en: Port authorities: suspend operations and secure vessels.
Keep away from ports, jetties and landing sites.
sw: Mamlaka za bandari: sitisheni shughuli na linda vyombo.
Kaa mbali na bandari, gati na mialo.

impact.en: Severe shoreline erosion and collapse of buildings
impact.sw: Mmomonyoko mkubwa wa kingo za maji na majengo kuanguka

en: Please move out of buildings on eroding shoreline.
Please do not return to undermined buildings.
Keep children away from cliff edges.
sw: Tafadhali hameni kutoka majengo yaliyo kwenye kingo zinazomomonyoka.
Tafadhali msirudi kwenye majengo ambayo misingi yake imeliwa na maji.
Waweke watoto mbali na kingo za majabali.

impact.en: Saltwater contamination of wells and springs
impact.sw: Maji ya chumvi kuchafua visima na chemchemi

en: Drink only boiled or treated water.
Do not use flooded wells until they have been cleaned and tested.
District Committees: supply safe drinking water.
sw: Kunywa maji yaliyochemshwa au kutibiwa tu.
Usitumie visima vilivyofurika hadi visafishwe na kupimwa.
Kamati za Wilaya: sambazeni maji safi ya kunywa.

impact.en: Flooding of lakeshore settlements
impact.sw: Mafuriko katika makazi ya kando ya maziwa

en: Lakeshore residents: please evacuate as directed.
Go to official shelters on higher ground.
Help older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities first.
sw: Wakazi wa kando ya maziwa: tafadhali hameni kama mnavyoelekezwa.
Nenda kwenye makazi rasmi ya muda yaliyo maeneo ya mwinuko.
Wasaidie wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu kwanza.

impact.en: Deaths and injuries
impact.sw: Vifo na majeruhi

en: Take the injured to the nearest health facility.
District Committees: set up first-aid points and provide psychosocial support.
Health authorities: manage identification and burial of the dead.
sw: Wapeleke majeruhi kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya huduma ya kwanza na toeni msaada wa kisaikolojia.
Mamlaka za afya: simamieni utambuzi na maziko ya waliofariki.

impact.en: Loss of boats, fishing gear and food stocks
impact.sw: Upotevu wa vyombo, zana za uvuvi na akiba ya chakula

en: Report losses to Village/Mtaa leaders and BMU.
District Committees: provide emergency food assistance.
sw: Toa taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa na BMU.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni msaada wa dharura wa chakula.

impact.en: Large-scale evacuation of coastal and lakeshore populations
impact.sw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa wakazi wa pwani na kando ya maziwa

en: Take your emergency bag.
Register at the shelter.
District Committees: provide food, water, sanitation and protection in shelters.
sw: Chukua begi lako la dharura.
Jisajili kwenye makazi ya muda.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni chakula, maji, huduma za usafi na ulinzi katika makazi ya muda.

impact.en: Roads, power and communication cut in coastal areas
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa barabara, umeme na mawasiliano katika maeneo ya pwani

en: Listen to official radio broadcasts.
Keep away from fallen power lines.
District Committees: use radio and messengers to reach cut-off villages.
sw: Sikiliza matangazo rasmi ya redio.
Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Kamati za Wilaya: tumieni redio na wajumbe kufikia vijiji visivyofikika.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please stay with official sources: radio, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the danger has passed and when it is safe to return.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hatari itakapokwisha na itakapokuwa salama kurudi.
